When two conclusions agree, it checks if they have identical functional roles: same set of triggered rules, same action recommendations. If so, they are the same claim.", "scope": {"covers": ["systems where conclusions directly influence actions or rule firings"], "excludes": ["purely descriptive systems without actuators"]}, "forbidden": [{"case": "Two conclusions with identical functional roles are kept separate", "eval": "program:functional_role_equivalence"}, {"case": "Two conclusions with different functional roles are merged", "eval": "program:functional_role_equivalence"}], "prose_notes": "Identity is determined by causal consequences.
